name: eli5-plus
title_zh: 复杂概念自己长成图解页，外行看完能复述
tagline_zh: 别再丢给用户一段干巴巴的维基百科。它把直觉、机制、例子、边界装进一张独立 HTML，动图讲透，外行看完能点头。
tagline_en: No more dumping raw wiki text. It packs intuition, mechanism, examples, and limits into one standalone HTML with.
desc_en: Create accurate visual explainers for non-specialists, covering intuition, mechanisms, examples, and boundaries in a standalone HTML page. Use when the user invokes ELI5+ (including $eli5-plus where supported) or asks to truly understand a complex topic through diagrams, examples, or meaningful animation. Not for ultra-brief summaries or expert-first technical deep dives.
why_zh: 它不堆术语，而是先给直觉再拆机制，用可交互动画和边界说明防止误解——比纯文字或静态图多一层“原来如此”…
why_en: It leads with intuition, then mechanism, using interactive animation and explicit boundaries—creating an 'aha' that static text.
limit_zh: 只做教学型图解，不做速查摘要或专家级深潜；输出是单文件 HTML，不含语音讲解或测验题。
limit_en: For teaching-style explainers only—not quick summaries or expert deep dives. Output is a standalone HTML; no narration or quizzes. Heavy math or.
title_en: Complex ideas become visual explainer pages laypeople can.
